definitions: Something laid as a covering over something else.
A transparent sheet placed over a picture or map to add additional details or information.
In computing, a section of code or data that is loaded into memory only when needed, replacing other sections.
A decorative or protective layer applied to a surface.
examples: The architect presented several design overlays.
The map included an overlay showing historical boundaries.
The software uses overlays to manage memory efficiently.
She added a gold overlay to the wooden box.
